items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And that's the first time I saw "Bullmoose"Jackson.

ctx.x: They stepped off that bus, man, say "God Damn," you know. I see other bands step off the bus look like they been through hell, man. Like the Lucky Millinder Band--those guys, they come off--step off the bus. Boy, their hair and shit's standing all up. And that's the first time I saw "Bullmoose"Jackson. But the band that really knocked me out, man--that I--the band that really, really, really knocked me out was Cootie Williams' big band.
